title: I verbi delle pulizie — Italian Verbs for Cleaning
source_summary: User-requested Italian vocabulary lesson covering cleaning-related verbs: sweep, wash, pile up, tidy, dust, scrub, rinse, dry, fold, hang laundry, vacuum, throw out trash.
learning_objectives: Recognize and pronounce 14 core Italian cleaning verbs.
Conjugate -are, -ere, and -isco regulars in the present tense.
Build practical sentences combining verbs with household nouns.
Use simple negative imperatives ('non + infinitive') in context.
Practice retrieval via fill-blank quiz and spaced-repetition cards.
